overview: The Medford Historical Commission determined 36 Mystic Street to be historically significant, conditionally accepted demolition applications for 17 Sharon Street and 85 Marshall Street, and received updates on the Medford Square rezoning and the Cross Street Cemetery exhumation project.

items.title: 36 Mystic Street - Demolition Application
items.summary: The commission approved the application for partial demolition to initiate the review process.

items.title: 36 Mystic Street - Determination of Significance
items.summary: The commission determined the property to be historically significant due to its architectural integrity and neighborhood history, advancing it to a future public hearing.

items.title: 17 Sharon Street - Demolition Application
items.summary: Approved the demolition application contingent on the applicant providing graphic drawings illustrating the proposed scope of work, and authorized hiring a consultant for a Massachusetts Historical Commission Form B.

items.title: 85 Marshall Street - Demolition Application
items.summary: Approved the demolition application contingent on receiving drawings clarifying proposed changes, and authorized an MHC Form B survey.

items.title: Upcoming Demolition Reviews
items.summary: Chair Hayward reported that a potential project at 119 Jerome Street may come before the commission and noted that all pending permit reviews were otherwise cleared.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning
items.summary: Commissioners discussed an upcoming joint meeting with the City Council on Medford Square rezoning, stressing the need to protect historic structures through design guidelines or historic districts.

items.title: Commission Appointments
items.summary: Chair Hayward reviewed the appointment status of prospective commissioners Sarah and Luke with the mayor's office.

items.title: 41 Mystic Street Demolition Delay Update
items.summary: Hayward reported that documentation discussions with the owner have stalled, suggesting the commission consider pursuing a local historic district or investigating building relocation options.

items.title: Brooks Estate and Thomas Brooks Park Projects
items.summary: Hayward provided updates on bidding an archaeological survey for the Brooks Estate and seeking lab space and volunteers to clean artifacts recovered from Thomas Brooks Park.

items.title: Cross Street Cemetery Exhumation and Restoration
items.summary: Hayward and Theresa Dupont discussed pending Community Preservation Committee review for headstone conservation and the upcoming bidding process to remove the City Hall upper parking lot to exhume unmarked graves.

items.title: Neighborhood Surveys
items.summary: Hayward announced that consultants have begun the Hastings Heights neighborhood survey and noted plans to seek a grant for the Brooks Estate area next cycle.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the previous meeting minutes.
